messages:
Marie: heads-up vendor pushed bulk H200 vessel by ~10 days. They can do an air-topoff of 6 units earlier, rest (24) on delayed vessel. Need call: accept partial air, reallocate, and negotiate RMA/dock fees. @Jordan @Alex
Jordan: paste vendor note and confirm if pricing/DOA changed?
Marie: vendor note:
```
ETA update: Sea ETA 2024-08-26. Air-topoff option: 6 units by 2024-08-16 (expedite fee applies). Unit price unchanged. RMA window 30 days; standard return freight unless waived. Serialized manifest available 48h before ship.
```
Alex: if we take 6 by air, we can plug SFO+DCA hot queues for ~48 hrs. APAC will still be short. Propose moving 4 of the 6 to APAC right after depot acceptance. We can cold migrate but some latency-sensitive tenants may impact.
Sam: rebalancing fine. Crucial ask: get serials before handoff so we can pre-provision node configs and image the nodes. Without manifest we'll incur ~1 day depot triage delay.
Jordan: negotiate: waive depot/dock fees and prepaid RMA labels for DOAs. If they won't waive, ask for invoice credit. Also request consolidated AWB for both air and sea shipments to simplify customs and returns.
Vendor Ops: vendor counter: can share serialized manifest 48hrs prior, escalate dock waiver internally. Offer: 2% credit on invoice if you take air-topoff and commit to follow-up order. Cannot commit to prepaid RMA labels unless credit accepted.
Marie: drafting reply: "We will accept the 6-unit air-topoff conditional on: 1) consolidated AWB for air+sea, 2) serialized manifest 48hrs prior, 3) waiver of depot/dock fees for delayed sea units or equivalent invoice credit, 4) prepaid RMA labels for DOA returns. Please confirm in writing." Sending now.
Jordan: if they hold at 2% push for 2% + waive expedite fee. Loop finance if they insist. Capture any agreed numeric credits.
Vendor Ops: vendor replies: "We can commit to serialized manifest 48hrs prior and will escalate waiver. If waiver not approved we can offer 1.5% invoice credit (final)."
Sam: run TCO quick calc: if we accept air with no waiver, extra expedite + dock fees ~ $18k, lost APAC capacity cost estimated $45k/week if we don't rebalance. I'll post numbers in an hour.
Alex: ops will prepare a short runbook to move 4 units to APAC and pre-stage images once manifest arrives. Also need depot contact and SLA for acceptance.
RMA-Bot: created draft playbook `rma-playbooks/air-topoff-fast-track.md` and label templates. Linking checklist in the thread.
Marie: attached playbook and asked vendor to confirm waiver or credit and to send consolidated AWB.
Vendor Ops: vendor replied: "We escalated; waiver pending. If waiver denied, 1.5% credit final. Serialized manifest will be sent 48h prior. Expedite fee can be offset by credit if you accept 2% and confirm next PO."
Jordan: capture final offer. I'll coordinate with finance on whether 1.5% is acceptable. If not, we may refuse partial and wait for vessel.
Marie: noted. Holding for finance decision and vendor final confirmation. Will update thread when vendor signs in writing.
